source.notes: Scanned school paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark). Printed header: ANNUAL EXAMINATION 2021-22, CLASS: VIII, SUBJECT: BIOLOGY, TIME: 2 HRS, MARKS: 100. examYear 2022 is the later year of the printed session 2021-22. Section A (60 marks, attempt all) is Question no.1 parts A-F (10 marks each; the labels of parts C, D and E and of the items of part F are cut off at the left edge of the scan and were inferred from the sequence). Section B (40 marks) says 'Attempt any four questions from this section. Each question carries ten marks' for Questions 2-6, so the pack total exceeds the 100-mark maximum; no choiceGroup is set because the choice is 'any four of five'. Question 6(b) has no legible printed mark (it is recorded with marks 0 and flagged). Part A-E groups carry one printed mark for the whole group and are kept as one entry each; part F prints [5x2=10] and is split into five 2-mark entries. Handwritten scores and ticks on the scan were ignored. A promotional footer (WhatsApp/Paytm offer) on page 4 is not part of the paper. No school name printed. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
